findings.message: The deterministic geometry gate failed because the expected floor opening 'opening-second-floor-slab-stair' was not found in the geometry feedback. The candidate declares void 'opening-second-floor-stair-void' against 'second-floor-slab', but the floor opening metrics remain empty. This must be revised so the stair opening is recognized under the deterministic geometry expectation; audit wording cannot override this gate failure.

The deterministic geometry gate also reports GEOMETRY_EXPECTATION_INCOMPLETE for the interior partition walls at /known_facts/storeys/0/walls/interior/0 and /known_facts/storeys/1/walls/interior/0 because it cannot derive a unique shared-boundary/thickness expectation. The candidate appears to contain the intended single partition wall on each storey, but the gate evidence is underspecified. This is a gate_dispute and remains blocking pending human/developer review; it cannot be accepted by audit.
